turns.text: Hi, this is Daniel Reyes with Harborview Insurance Agency in Cleveland. This call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?
I’d like to add my daughter to my car insurance. She just got her license.
Congratulations to her! Could I get the policyholder’s name and policy number so I can pull it up?
I’m Priya Raman, and my policy number is N-B-M, four-four-one-eight, two-zero-seven.
I found your Northbeam Mutual policy. I have 1427 Belle Avenue, Lakewood, Ohio, 44107. What’s your daughter’s full name and date of birth?
Maya Raman, M-A-Y-A. Her birthday is March 14th, 2009, and she’s seventeen.
I have Maya Raman, born March 14th, 2009. Which state issued her license, what kind is it, and has she had any tickets or accidents?
Ohio. Her probationary license, she passed last Tuesday. No tickets, nothing.
Which car will she drive most? List Maya as the primary driver on the car she will actually drive most; rating her on the wrong car can cause trouble at claim time. And where is it parked overnight?
The Civic. She'll drive it every day to school, and it's parked at home, 44107.

With a B average, a 3.0 GPA or better, she qualifies for the good-student discount; send a report card within 30 days. With a new teen driver many families raise liability limits from 50/100 to 100/300; that would add about $11 a month.
She has a 3.6 GPA. Let’s keep the limits as they are for now.
When would you like Maya added to the policy?
Next Friday, October 2nd. That’s when she starts driving to school.
So that’s Maya, primary on the Civic, starting Friday, October 2nd. With the good-student discount included, the new premium is $142 a month, up $46 from your $96.
Oof, that’s a bit much, but okay. Go ahead.
OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.
You’ll hear my assistant in a second. Thanks for calling.
